sloka: ताभ्यश्चैवाहृतं तो यं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः ।सलाजाः क्षीरिभिश्छन्ना घटाः काञ्चनराजताः ॥२-१५-७॥
transliteration: tābhyaścaivāhṛtaṁ to yaṁ samudrebhyaśca sarvaśaḥ ।salājāḥ kṣīribhiśchannā ghaṭāḥ kāñcanarājatāḥ ॥2-15-7॥

translations.english: Gold and silver vessels filled with holy water and puffed corn, adorned with lotuses, water lilies and leaves from trees rich in sap shone.
